name: Giuseppe Conte
detail: Repeatedly rejected a national wealth tax in 2024–2026 ("La tassa sui ricchi è stata fatta in tanti Paesi e non ha mai funzionato"; stated he studied and discarded a patrimoniale while at Palazzo Chigi), while accepting only an EU/global measure or M5S's partial financial-assets levy.

name: Matteo Renzi
detail: Leader of Italia Viva; explicitly opposes a wealth tax, calling it an "autogol" that would trigger capital flight and hit the middle class.

name: Giorgia Meloni
detail: Prime Minister and leader of Fratelli d'Italia; repeatedly ruled out any wealth tax ("con noi mai nessuna patrimoniale").

name: Stefano Fassina
detail: As Chamber Budget Committee rapporteur in December 2020, gave a negative opinion on the Orfini-Fratoianni wealth tax amendment while stating generically "Dobbiamo riordinare le imposte patrimoniali ma con una proposta adeguata".

name: Pierpaolo Bombardieri
detail: UIL General Secretary; campaigns for an extra tax on corporate windfall profits (extraprofitti) in banking, energy, pharma and defence rather than a tax on net personal wealth.

name: Carlo Cottarelli
detail: Economist and former senator; criticised a net wealth tax in Il Foglio as unjust double taxation.

name: Antonio Misiani
detail: PD head of economics; ruled out a new national wealth tax in November 2025 while noting the PES manifesto backed a European-level measure on the super-rich.
